title: Sections server function returns sections for a course code and term (mocked NYU)
preconditions: Signed in as a test student. NYU class search mocked to return, for term Fall 2026, three sections of the requested code CSCI-UA 101 (001 LEC 'TR 2-3:15p' with meetingTimes empty, instr 'Test Prof A', 2026-09-02 to 2026-12-14; 002 LEC 'M 2-4:30p'; 003 LEC 'T 11a-1:30p') plus one section of a similar code CSCI-UA 1010. Fake now: 2026-11-26T15:00:00Z.
steps: Call the sections server function for course code 'CSCI-UA 101' and term Fall 2026
expected: Exactly the 3 sections of CSCI-UA 101 are returned (the similar code is filtered out). Each has section no., type 'LEC', meeting text, parsed weekly meetings, start date 2026-09-02, end date 2026-12-14 and instructor.

title: Meeting-text parser: 'TR 2-3:15p'
preconditions: Meeting-text parser unit test; no network.
expected: Two weekly meetings: Tuesday 14:00-15:15 and Thursday 14:00-15:15 (start inherits pm from end).

title: Meeting-text parser: 'M 2-4:30p', 'T 11a-1:30p', 'T 4:55-6:55p'
preconditions: Meeting-text parser unit test; no network.
expected: 'M 2-4:30p' → Monday 14:00-16:30. 'T 11a-1:30p' → Tuesday 11:00-13:30 (start stays am, crossing noon). 'T 4:55-6:55p' → Tuesday 16:55-18:55.

title: meetingTimes JSON is used when present (meet_day 0 = Monday)
preconditions: Mocked section with meets 'T 4:55-6:55p' and meetingTimes [{meet_day:"1",start_time:"1655",end_time:"1855"}].
steps: Map the mocked section through the server function / parser
expected: One meeting on Tuesday 16:55-18:55 (meet_day 1 = Tuesday, not Monday).

title: TBA and unparseable meeting text return the section with no meetings
preconditions: Mocked sections with meets 'TBA', '' and 'Does not meet', meetingTimes empty.
steps: Call the sections server function / parser for these sections
expected: All three sections are returned (with section no., instructor, dates), each with an empty meetings list; no error is thrown.

title: Sections server function rejects signed-out callers
preconditions: Not signed in (no session). NYU mocked.
steps: Call the sections server function without an auth session
expected: Request is rejected as unauthorized; no section data is returned and NYU is not called.

title: Subjects dialog: pick a section after adding a course
preconditions: Signed in as test student with no classes. NYU mocked as in TC-01. Fake now: 2026-11-26T15:00:00Z.
steps: Open the section choice for that course
expected: A list shows each section with section no., days/times (e.g. 'TR 2-3:15p' / Tue & Thu 2:00-3:15 pm) and instructor. After choosing 001 it is shown as the selected section and is saved.

title: Subjects dialog: choosing a section is optional
preconditions: Signed in as test student. NYU mocked.
steps: Add CSCI-UA 101 and do not choose a section
expected: Class is added and appears in 'Your classes' exactly as before this feature; no saved section exists; no error or forced step.

title: Set section for an existing class from the class page
preconditions: Signed in; enrolled in CSCI-UA 101 with no section. NYU mocked.
expected: Section 002 ('M 2-4:30p') is saved and shown on the class page; reloading keeps it.

title: Change section from the 'Your classes' list
preconditions: Signed in; enrolled in CSCI-UA 101 with saved section 002. NYU mocked.
steps: Use the change-section action on CSCI-UA 101
expected: Saved section becomes 003 ('T 11a-1:30p'); only one saved row exists for this student+class (replaced, not duplicated).

title: Saved section row contains all required fields
preconditions: Test database/mocked Supabase; TC-07 done.
steps: Inspect the class_sections row for the test student and CSCI-UA 101
expected: Row has user_id, class_id, term, section_no '001', meets 'TR 2-3:15p', meetings JSON (Tue/Thu 14:00-15:15), start_date 2026-09-02, end_date 2026-12-14; unique per (user, class).

title: RLS: a student cannot read or write another student's section rows
preconditions: Two test students A and B (test data only, or RLS policy review against mocked client). B has a saved section.
steps: As A, try to insert a row with user_id = B
As A, try to update/delete B's row
expected: A sees only own rows (none of B's). Insert/update/delete on B's row are denied or affect 0 rows. Migration enables RLS with own-row policies for select/insert/update/delete.

title: Removing a class removes its saved section
preconditions: Signed in; enrolled in CSCI-UA 101 with saved section 001.
steps: Check class_sections and the home page
expected: No class_sections row remains for that class; home card no longer uses it.

title: Next lecture within 24 h shows split-flap HH:MM:SS countdown
expected: Card reads 'CSCI-UA 101 starts in' (class name) with digits 03:30:00, ticking to 03:29:59, 03:29:58 each second; only digits that change flip.

title: Next lecture more than 24 h away shows day and time
preconditions: Saved section 001 'TR 2-3:15p'. Fake now: Fri 2026-11-27 12:00 New York (17:00Z).
expected: Card shows next lecture 'Tue 2:00 pm' (CSCI-UA 101); no split-flap countdown.

title: Soonest meeting chosen across multiple classes
preconditions: Next-lecture calculation unit test. Sections: A 'TR 2-3:15p', B 'M 2-4:30p', C 'T 11a-1:30p', all 2026-09-02 to 2026-12-14. Fake now: Mon 2026-11-30 09:00 New York (14:00Z).
expected: Next = class B, Mon 2026-11-30 14:00 New York (19:00Z). At fake now Mon 2026-11-30 17:00 New York (22:00Z) next = class C Tue 11:00 (2026-12-01T16:00:00Z).

title: DST end (Sun 2026-11-01, New York): wall-clock time is kept
steps: Fake now: Sat 2026-10-31 12:00 EDT (16:00Z); compute next lecture
Fake now: Sun 2026-11-01 12:00 EST (17:00Z); compute next lecture and countdown
expected: Both: next lecture = Mon 2026-11-02 9:30 am New York = 2026-11-02T14:30:00Z (not 13:30Z). First case is 46h30m away → 'Mon 9:30 am'. Second case is 21h30m away → countdown 21:30:00.

title: DST start (Sun 2027-03-14, New York): wall-clock time is kept
steps: Fake now: Sat 2027-03-13 12:00 EST (17:00Z); compute next lecture
Fake now: Sun 2027-03-14 12:00 EDT (16:00Z); compute countdown
expected: Next lecture = Mon 2027-03-15 9:30 am New York = 2027-03-15T13:30:00Z (not 14:30Z). First case 44h30m → 'Mon 9:30 am'. Second case → countdown 21:30:00 (not 22:30:00).

title: Meetings outside the section's start/end dates are ignored
steps: Fake now: Sat 2026-08-29 12:00 New York; compute next lecture
Fake now: Thu 2026-12-10 16:00 New York; compute next lecture
expected: First: Thu 2026-09-03 2:00 pm (not Tue 2026-09-01, before start). Second: none upcoming (Tue 2026-12-15 is after end date).

title: Happening now, then moves to next lecture when it ends
preconditions: Saved sections A 'TR 2-3:15p' and C 'T 4:55-6:55p'. Fake now: Tue 2026-12-01 15:13:30 New York (20:13:30Z); clock advances.
expected: Card shows 'CSCI-UA 101 · happening now · ends in 01:30' (or similar) counting down. After 15:15 it switches to class C 'starts in 01:40:00' countdown.

title: No saved sections: card invites student to set sections
preconditions: Signed in; enrolled in a class but no saved sections. Fake now: 2026-11-26T15:00:00Z.
expected: Card invites the student to set their sections (no countdown); action opens the section picker (subjects dialog or class page / Your classes).

title: Sections saved but term over: card says no upcoming lectures
preconditions: Saved section 'TR 2-3:15p' ending 2026-12-14. Fake now: Fri 2026-12-18 12:00 New York.
expected: Card states there are no upcoming lectures (e.g. term over); no countdown and no error.

title: Reduce motion: digits update without flip animation
preconditions: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Setup as TC-14 (fake now Tue 2026-12-01 10:30 New York).
expected: Digits change each second with no flip/3D animation (no running animation/transition on digit elements).

title: Screen reader: time announced in words, not every second
preconditions: Setup as TC-14. Inspect accessibility tree.
steps: Observe live region updates over 10 seconds
expected: Accessible text reads in words, e.g. 'CSCI-UA 101 starts in 3 hours 30 minutes'; individual flap digits are hidden from assistive tech; no per-second announcements (any live region updates at most per minute or is polite/static).

title: NYU lookup failure shows message with Try again; class can still be added
preconditions: Signed in. NYU mocked to fail (HTTP 500 / timeout) on first call, succeed on second.
steps: In subjects dialog add CSCI-UA 101 and open section choice
Repeat with persistent failure and finish adding the class
expected: Clear message that NYU sections couldn't be loaded with a 'Try again' button; retry loads the list. With persistent failure the class is still added successfully.

title: 390 px phone width: card, subjects dialog and section picker
preconditions: Viewport 390x844. Setup as TC-14, then TC-07.
steps: Open subjects dialog and section list
expected: Countdown card and digits fit without horizontal scroll or clipped text; section list rows (no., times, instructor) readable and tappable.

title: Regression: subjects dialog and home page otherwise unchanged
preconditions: Signed in test student with existing classes and notes. NYU mocked.
steps: Search and add a subject, remove a subject in the subjects dialog
Open home page; check existing sections (classes list, notes/summaries links)
Open a class page and its notes
expected: Search/add/remove work as before; home page content other than the new card is unchanged; class page and notes work; no console errors.

title: Typecheck, unit tests and build pass
preconditions: Feature branch checked out, dependencies installed.
steps: Run unit tests (meeting-text parser, next-lecture incl. DST)
expected: All three succeed with no errors; parser and next-lecture tests (incl. DST cases) exist and pass.
